unlisted_practices: Zero-shot LLM prompting to extract structured clinical descriptors from free-text EHR notes, compared against expert human annotation
Comparison of larger versus smaller LLM (GPT-4o vs GPT-4o mini) on extraction performance

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the capability of zero-shot LLM prompts to extract clinical descriptors of microbial keratitis from EHR notes compared to human annotation, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
